title: Rakhish bar Pappa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Chullin 42b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.42b.7) and [55a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.55a.10), speaking in Rav’s name.[^1]

notes.text: The two passages and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3230&lang=en) preserve the same attribution: Rakhish bar Pappa reports in Rav’s name.
